21.title: A New Heaven and a New Earth
21.text: John saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away. And the holy city, new Jerusalem, came down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband. A great voice from the throne announced, 'Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God.' And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away. Behold, I make all things new. The city had no need of the sun, for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.
